metadata.description: Three small Claude Code mods: hide .env values from tool results, see how far your plan is, and get warned when a task is marked done with untested code.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Hides your project's .env values from tool results before Claude reads them

plugins.name: plan-meter
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with how far your plan file is (phases and steps done, what is in progress, what is next) and Claude's own task list

plugins.name: done-gate
plugins.description: Warns Claude and you when a task is marked done while code it changed has not been tested since; a band shows the last test run. It never blocks
